inspection.mapping: Printed page = physical page + 28; physical page 6 is the OCW footer.

limits: Source FSD sufficiency argument assumes continuous strictly increasing CDFs; manuscript proves the finite-atom result directly.
Source integrated-CDF display uses t >= 0 despite a general bounded support. Manuscript uses all real t and handles endpoint atoms.

Source equal-mean theorem states a coupling equivalence but the printed proof supplies spread-to-preference and integrated-CDF equivalence. Manuscript supplies its own finite coupling converse; no claim that this missing direction was read.

limits: Actual substantive web-extracted text was read. Direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; no retained PDF bytes/hash or actual equation-image inspection is claimed. Screenshot requests did not return viewable image blocks. No access workaround attempted.
Pages 8–13 and the original Blackwell 1951/1953 papers were not inspected.

The extracted proof on page 6 says non-negative after ruling out a positive entry of PM−Q; that step requires nonpositive. Without a viewed page image this is recorded as an extracted-text inconsistency, not a certified print typo. The manuscript uses an independent nearest-point separation proof, not that display.

originality: All manuscript proofs, six cases and twelve prompts/solutions are original. Inspected primary scopes inform definitions and theorem context; no source exercises reproduced.
